title: 1024px Flux Schnell images get a new worker route
summary:
A compact tuning pass: larger Flux Schnell images get a new route, docs become easier to navigate, and text gains a more grounded persona.

Flux Schnell generation at 1024×1024 now uses Cloudflare AI Workers, improving the path for larger image requests while the surrounding image plumbing gets a few small fixes.

The documentation now points developers to a pollinations npm module and a server-status dashboard. Less archaeology before the first API call.

A new realistic persona with deliberately balanced personality traits is available for more grounded character-driven text interactions.
